subject: MAP Sprint: alpha draft, roles, and 30-day close milestones
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:23:00 -0000
Subject: MAP Sprint: alpha draft, roles, and 30-day close milestones

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I pulled together an alpha MAP (Mutual Action Plan) that focuses on a 30-day technical evaluation and a clear acceptance path so your team can validate latency and integration with AcmePay’s gateway. The goal for this sprint is:

- Confirm technical owners and run a short integration sanity test (week 1)
- Complete security questionnaire + SOC evidence (week 1–2)
- Run performance validation on a 5k request/day sample (week 2–3)
- Acceptance test and sign-off (end of week 4)

Drafts attached and linked below:
- MAP-alpha-template-v1.gdoc (alpha draft)
- MAP-alpha-stakeholder-roster.gslides (owner names and meeting slots)

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_map_alpha_draft
       https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1A_map_alpha_slides

Ask: can you confirm the primary technical owner on your side and a preferred weekly cadence? Also flag any regulatory constraints we should surface in the security run.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (solutions) and Ben (technical PM) — they’ll own delivery on the Redwood side.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0127

[Attachments: MAP-alpha-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc), MAP-alpha-stakeholder-roster.gslides (Slides)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmepay.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:11:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP Sprint: alpha draft, roles, and 30-day close milestones

Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the structure. A few quick notes from our side:

- Primary tech owner: Jordan Lee (CC’d). He’ll need to validate the SDK integration and token routing.
- Regulatory: we need TLS termination details and data residency notes for EU customers (we operate in both US/EU).
- Timeline: week 2 is tight for our security team — can we shift the perf validation to week 3 and keep week 2 for security and remediation?

Also, can you add an explicit acceptance checklist (what counts as "pass" for performance and integration)?

Thanks,
Elena
Senior PM, Platform Integrations | AcmePay

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 17:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP Sprint: alpha draft, roles, and 30-day close milestones

Elena / Kimberly —

Thanks — I updated the alpha slides to include a concise acceptance checklist and added a technical runbook section for the integration steps. Highlights:

- Acceptance criteria (short):
  • API integration completes end-to-end with <200ms median added latency under sample load
  • KV cache hit rate >70% for repeated requests in the test set
  • No PII persisted to Redwood logs; configured KMS for key rotation

- Runbook: SDK install, example requests, sample dataset (anonymized), and a smoke-test script.

I attached the slide pack and a short checklist PDF. Ben

[Attachment: MAP-alpha-stakeholder-roster.gslides (Slides), prod-onboarding-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@acmepay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 13:45:00 -0000
Subject: Updated MAP alpha doc and proposed week-by-week sprint

Hi all —

I pulled Ben’s runbook content into the MAP document and created a week-by-week sprint plan based on Elena’s ask to move security earlier. Summary below and link to the live doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_map_alpha_draft (updated)

Proposed cadence (revised):
- Week 0 (prep): access, service accounts, sample dataset delivered
- Week 1: SDK integration + smoke test (Redwood/AcmePay joint session)
- Week 2: Security questionnaire, SOC evidence review, remediation window
- Week 3: Performance validation (5k/day sample); run acceptance checklist
- Week 4: Final sign-off + playbook handoff

Action items:
- Jordan: please confirm availability for a 90-min integration session (preferably Wed AM PT, week 1).
- Elena: confirm whether EU data residency needs to be added as a hard blocker or an informational note.
- Kimberly: please confirm whether we should budget a 10% contingency for extra perf runs.

I also added a simple stakeholder RACI slide with owners (link to slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1A_map_alpha_slides).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP Sprint: alpha draft, roles, and 30-day close milestones

Appreciate the quick align — two small updates before the joint session:

1) Jordan — can you confirm Wed 12 May 10:00 AM PT for the 90-min integration run? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with agenda.
2) Elena — we’ll add an explicit EU residency flag in the MAP and mark it as a "regulatory blocker" if you confirm it needs to be enforced for production.
3) I’m allocating a 10% contingency for perf runs unless you push back. We can revisit after week 1.

Next steps: I’ll circulate the calendar invite + pre-read (MAP alpha doc) and Ben/Marissa will own the runbook and acceptance checklist updates.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Kimberly
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

[Calendar invite to follow; Attachment references: MAP-alpha-template-v1.gdoc, MAP-alpha-stakeholder-roster.gslides]
